_meta.description: Reference assumptions for Person 3's renewable (solar) sizing calculation. Values are published, cited figures for Sri Lanka — update as newer official data / vendor quotes become available.

_meta.source: Sri Lanka Sustainable Energy Authority (energy.gov.lk) — national GHI range 1,247–2,106 kWh/m2/year, lowland higher than mountainous; cross-checked against ADB (2017) national estimate of 4-6 kWh/m2/day.
_meta.notes: These are broad regional TIERS, not per-district figures — no officially published per-district table was found. For a specific site, prefer real coordinates via the Global Solar Atlas (globalsolaratlas.info) if precision matters (e.g. final quotation stage). Use these tiers for scoping/estimation only.

lowland_coastal.description: Coastal belt and low-elevation areas (e.g. Colombo, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Hambantota) — highest end of the national GHI range.

mid_country.description: Mid-elevation, partially cloud-affected areas (e.g. Kurunegala, Kandy outskirts, Ratnapura) — national average.

hill_country.description: Central highlands / mountainous areas (e.g. Nuwara Eliya, higher parts of Badulla) — lowest end of the national GHI range due to persistent cloud cover and shadowing.

system_efficiency.source: Typical grid-tied PV system performance ratio accounting for inverter, wiring, soiling and temperature losses (industry standard range 75-85%; NREL PVWatts methodology).
system_efficiency.notes: This is a derating factor applied to theoretical panel output, not panel efficiency itself.

on_grid_no_battery.source: Sri Lanka commercial solar market estimate, 2026 (on-grid/net-accounting system, no battery storage)
on_grid_no_battery.source_note: stanthonyssolar.lk 2026 cost guide; cross-checked against multiple vendor-quoted ranges. VERIFY against current vendor quotes before presenting a final client-facing number — this is a scoping estimate, not a quotation.

net_accounting_export.source: PUCSL rooftop solar feed-in tariff revision, August 2026 (valid through February 2027)
net_accounting_export.notes: Actual rate depends on system capacity band (e.g. systems up to 10kW get the higher end). Default used here is the approximate midpoint; recompute with the exact band once system size is known if precision matters for the client report.
